metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'MDE - Shadow Copy / Recovery Inhibited'

properties.description:
Detects command lines that delete volume shadow copies, delete the backup
catalog, or disable Windows recovery. This is the pre-encryption step of
virtually every ransomware affiliate playbook (Conti/LockBit/Black Basta/
Akira lineage): destroy the recovery path first so the victim cannot restore
without paying. Taken alone it is extremely high-signal — legitimate
administrators do not typically run `vssadmin delete shadows /all` on
workstations.
properties.query:
// Interpreters and utilities that legitimately own shadow-copy management.
let recovery_tools = dynamic([
  "vssadmin.exe", "wmic.exe", "wbadmin.exe", "bcdedit.exe",
  "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "diskshadow.exe", "cmd.exe"
]);
// Term pairs are evaluated with has_any, which matches whole terms; keep each
// entry as a phrase an attacker would actually type.
let destruction_terms = dynamic([
  "delete shadows",
  "shadowcopy delete",
  "delete catalog",
  "delete systemstatebackup",
  "recoveryenabled no",
  "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
  "win32_shadowcopy",
  "resize shadowstorage",
  "delete shadows /all /quiet"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where FileName in~ (recovery_tools)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (destruction_terms)
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Shadow copy or recovery deletion on {{DeviceName}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{FileName}} on {{DeviceName}} was invoked with a command line that deletes shadow copies, the backup catalog, or Windows recovery: {{ProcessCommandLine}}
